text.description_html:
PDQ SD Series Heavy Duty Grade 2 Commercial Door Levers

Miami style commercial levers are heavy duty Grade 2 and economical priced. Available in a wide selection of functions and finishes.

Complies with ANSI/BHMA A156.2-1996, Series 4000, Grade 2. Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of A label (3 hours) and less, UL10C / UBC 7-2 (1997) positive pressure, for single doors up to 4'0" x 8'0"

Assembled in the USA meeting the requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant levers are solid cast, with no plastic inserts, and fully adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" doors.

Specificatios:

  • Door Thickness: Adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick.
  • Door Prep: Fits standard 160 and161 door prep.
  • Backsets: 2-3/4",2-3/8".
  • Case: Heavy gauge cold-rolled steel mechanism. Dichromated for corrosion resistance
  • Front: 2-1/4" X 1-1/8" or 2-1/4" Beveled 1/8" on 2".
  • Strike: 4-7/8" X 1-1/4" (Standard ASA). Stainless steel, or wrought brass.
  • Latchbolt: 1/2" throw.
  • Handing: Non-handed.
  • Trim: Miami levers solid zinc diecast.
  • Keyways: Schlage "C" Standard.
  • Cylinder: Brass 6-pin cylinder keyed to 5-pins.

Available Functions:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim, one (1) side.
  • Double Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim, both (2) sides.
  • Communicating: Latch bolt operated by inside lever. Blank plate outside.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
  • Keyed Entry: Outside lever locked and unlocked by key. Push/Turn button locking inside. When outside lever is locked by Pushing and Turning inside button, using the key from outside unlatches door but does not unlock outside lever.
  • Classroom: Outside lever locked and unlocked by key. Inside lever always unlocked.
  • Storeroom: Outside lever fixed. Entry by key only. Inside lever always unlocked.
  • Exit Twin Communicating: Inside lever locked with key. Latch bolt operated by inside lever. Blank plate outside.
  • Office Entry: Outside lever locked and unlocked by key. Push button locking inside. Turning inside lever unlocks outside.
  • Store Door (Double Cylinder): Outside and Inside lever locked and unlocked by key.
